title: Supplied cluster reports
source:
California's Proposition 40: What voters need to know about the billionaire wealth tax
California's Proposition 40, which would impose a wealth tax on billionaires, is polling as a close race ahead of the November 3 election. The measure represents a significant test of voter appetite for aggressive taxation on ultra-high net worth individuals.
California voters’ major shift on billionaire tax revealed in new poll
A new poll shows a significant shift in California voters' views on Proposition 40, a proposed one-time 5% wealth tax on billionaires.
Are California voters about to impose 'world's first' tax on billionaires?
California voters are deciding whether to impose a tax on billionaires to fund healthcare improvements, potentially creating the world's first such tax. The measure represents a significant test of wealth taxation at the state level.
